description: Known bug patterns for Log Investigator auto-triage. Swap TBD-GC-* keys for real Jira issue keys when available.

issues.name: AFT transfer type naming mismatch
triggerPatterns: AFT REQUESTED AND OBTAINED TRANSFER AMOUNTS MISMATCH
issues.probableCause: Known issue GCI-AFT-001: AFT transfer bucket labels differ across sasmsgr, Aurum, OneHand (promo:0 / cashable:0 pool tags), SlotLog, and WAT meters. Use aft_transfer.correlate_aft_transfer or issues/GCI-AFT-001-transfer-type-naming.md. :0 is pool index, not amount.

issues.name: Ruleta BiOS plugin missing
issues.probableCause: Known issue GCI-ROULETTE-001: Ruleta BiOS plugin DLL absent from C:\goldclub\data\bios\plugins. Redeploy BiOS plugin pack or restore from known-good image.

issues.name: SAS controller config missing
issues.probableCause: Known issue GCI-ROULETTE-002: Aurum SASControler messenger config not found. Verify AurumSetup.xml and config\etc\application\aurum\SASControler1\.

issues.name: Ruleta MessageDispatcher fault
issues.probableCause: Known issue GCI-ROULETTE-003: Ruleta GUI message dispatch fault — often InvalidOperationException (sequence empty) during spin/bonus. Collect ruleta\ log + preceding WARN/INFO.

issues.name: Empty stream deserialization
triggerPatterns: Attempting to deserialize an empty stream
issues.probableCause: Known issue GCI-ROULETTE-004: Persisted state blob empty or corrupt — check var\state, recent factory reset, and config save timing.

issues.name: Aurum setup XML missing
issues.probableCause: Known issue GCI-ROULETTE-005: AurumSetup.xml missing — verify aurum config path and factory deploy.

issues.name: Roulette number on screen mismatch
issues.probableCause: Known issue GCI-ROULETTE-006: Wheel/sensor result disagrees with on-screen number (ruleta Roulette ERRO). Correlate READBALL / HIT / STOP ON INDEX in the same second and check RNG/wheel hardware.

issues.name: Roulette ERROR N screen (Godot UI closed)
issues.probableCause: Known issue GCI-ROULETTE-007: Classic Roulette ERROR N window interrupted the game (Godot UI closed). ERROR 30 after RAM clear is leftover ruleta/persistent (RouletteActivate.dat), not DataBase.db and not leftover Aurum XML. ERROR 99 is a fresh LLAVE bind (Dongle mismatch). See data/roulette_error_catalog.json.

issues.name: Godot unhandled GUI exception
issues.probableCause: Known issue GCI-GODOT-001: Godot roulette GUI unhandled exception (often NullReference on payout). Check Missing node WARN for TokenSpawner/TouchInner and backend pay state.

issues.name: Godot process killed or unexpected exit
triggerPatterns: Godot did not exit in expected time
issues.probableCause: Known issue GCI-GODOT-002: Godot renderer hung, crashed, or parent ruleta process ended — correlate godot\ and ruleta\ timestamps.

issues.name: Godot QueueData deserialization fault
issues.probableCause: Known issue GCI-GODOT-003: Godot UI queue payload fault — null lock/bet state from backend; pair with ruleta MessageDispatcher errors.

issues.name: Unable to bet/cashout until chip selected (denom vs chip index)
triggerPatterns: Unable to bet and cashout until you select a chip
issues.probableCause: Known issue RSW-6452 / Xray RSW-6534: chip GUI position higher than enabled denomination count leaves betting stuck until another chip is selected. Reproduce with automation/xray_recipes/RSW-6534.yaml (bill inject + mapped clicks).

issues.name: Wrong trial serial shows ERROR 30 with CABINET_DOOR text
issues.probableCause: Known bug GCI-ROULETTE-008 (lab .90, 2026-07-27): entering a wrong trial/serial on the licence ERROR 30 (LLAVE) screen shows door-open text MONITOR position:1 ABIERTA / CABINET_DOOR instead of a serial-validation failure. Evidence: _tmp_logs/bug_evidence/wrong_serial_error30/. ERROR 30 is the trial UI (RSW-2473); door wording normally belongs to ERROR 31 switch family.
